summary_en: 106,700 shares (2.4% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) to be acquired for ¥300.1M maximum via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-15 at closing price ¥2,813/share.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 (self-tender off-market transaction)
translation_en_brief: On 12 June 2026, SAKURASAKU PLUS Co., Ltd. announced a treasury share acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-market transaction. The company will place a purchase order on 15 June 2026 at 08:45 JST for up to 106,700 shares (2.4% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, calculated as 106,700 ÷ 4,454,216) at the previous day's closing price of ¥2,813 per share, for a maximum total outlay of ¥300,147,100. The purchase will be executed as a single-slot ToSTNeT-3 transaction only, with results announced immediately after execution. The company stated the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns and support flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions. The announcement notes that the former CEO had indicated an intention to sell his shareholding.
